tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Full UCP product records for up to 6 products by id or handle, in one call. Use get_product for one.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The full UCP product record: description, images, categories, colors, sizes, decoration methods, price range, minimum quantity, lead time, and whether a free sample is offered. For a price at a specific quantity, call quote_price.
